document_title: Project Undercurrent: South Lhonak Glacial Lake Satellite Validation Record
generation_method: Automated pipeline execution on Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance rasters

lake_isolation_methodology.spatial_mask: Georeferenced South Lhonak Basin AOI Polygon (EPSG:4326 reprojected to EPSG:32645 via rasterio.warp.transform_geom)
lake_isolation_methodology.seed_selection_strategy: Inverse affine transform (~src.transform) locates exact pixel in scene space; selects contiguous waterbody component and excludes peripheral tarns/scree pools
lake_isolation_methodology.ground_area_derivation: Exact pixel resolution from affine transform matrix (|res[0]| * |res[1]| = 100.02 m² in UTM Zone 45N)
lake_isolation_methodology.scientific_rationale: Scene-wide thresholding without spatial masking included neighbouring tarns, producing an artificial +0.01% change in early QGIS masks. Georeferenced basin AOI isolation isolates true moraine breach outflow.

pre_outburst_baseline.threshold_rationale: Threshold 0.20 isolates open deep glacial water while rejecting dry moraine and lateral scree.

post_outburst_state.threshold_rationale: Threshold 0.265 isolates deep standing water from freshly exposed moist sediment scar in drained lake basin.

empirical_breach_outflow.drainage_interpretation: Catastrophic moraine breach causing rapid uncontrolled drainage of ~0.690 km² of glacial water spread (-41.4% planar contraction).

regional_benchmark_alignment_and_date_do.alignment_statement: Undercurrent compares empirical Sentinel-2 Level-2A scenes with published ISRO NRSC emergency mapping reports. Note on acquisition dates: ISRO/NRSC published rapid assessments evaluated 17-Sep-2023 (1.682 km²) and 04-Oct-2023 (1.031 km²). Undercurrent processes cloud-free Sentinel-2 Level-2A acquisitions on 26-Sep-2023 (pre-burst baseline) and 09-Oct-2023 (post-stabilisation). While dates differ due to orbital overpass and cloud cover constraints, our empirical measurements (1.666 km² pre-burst and 0.976 km² post-burst) confirm consistent physical magnitude (~41% drainage loss) with independent national agency reports.

scientific_disclaimer: This analysis measures planar 2D water-spread change from satellite reflectance data. Water volume drainage cannot be directly determined without bathymetric lakebed depth contours. This prototype supports preliminary situational screening and does NOT replace government flood early warning models.
